provider: azure open datasets (as a hosting programme)

free_tier.stated: No byte allowance is published for contributed data. Microsoft pays the storage cost of hosting Azure Open Datasets, and most datasets are free to read.

egress.terms: Reads of large datasets can be charged to the reading Azure subscription as egress (read operations plus network bandwidth); most datasets are free to access.

identity_cost.detail: Reading the datasets needs no Azure account.

reliability_note: Curated catalogue of public datasets. A dataset is contributed by emailing a request that states the dataset size and its expected yearly growth; no application form, quota or size limit is published. There is no SLA or availability guarantee for the datasets.
confidence_note: Re-read on 2026-11-03 from the vendor pages https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/products/open-datasets (Microsoft pays hosting storage costs; no SLA; egress can be charged to the reading subscription; no additional charge for most datasets) and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/open-datasets/overview-what-are-open-datasets (public datasets can be shared through the programme; a contribute-a-dataset email link whose template lists dataset size and expected yearly growth; no Azure account is needed to read). Confidence stays reported: the verdict text says there is no intake route, and the Learn page states an email contribution route; neither page states a quota.
